newsitem.title: CHINA: OMRON to invest 50 bln yen to China by 200.
newsitem.headline: OMRON to invest 50 bln yen to China by 200.

text.p: Japan's OMRON Co plans to boost its total investment in China to 50 billion yen ($427 million) by the end of 2000 from $40 million currently, an official of its OMRON (China) Group Co said on Monday.
The company planned to increase its Chinese joint ventures to about 20 from nine firms at present, the official said.
OMRON produces programmable logic controllers, widely used by large Chinese enterprises, such as First Auto Works, Beijing Jeep Co, and Beijing Yanshan Petrochemical Co, he said.
Other products ranged from medical equipment to sensors and timers, he said, without giving further details.
